{
  "dataset_name": "credit_g",
  "model_family": "tree",
  "schema_generator": "claude-sonnet-4.6",
  "schema_version": "1.0",
  "features": [
    {
      "name": "checking_status_ordinal",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Ordinal encoding of checking account status from most negative to most positive balance, with no checking account as a separate high-risk indicator mapped to 0",
      "value_range": [0, 4],
      "feature_family": "account_status",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Enables tree splits on ordered checking account balance levels, capturing monotonic risk relationship",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "np.where(checking_status == 'no checking', 0, np.where(checking_status == '<0', 1, np.where(checking_status == '0<=X<200', 2, np.where(checking_status == '>=200', 3, 0))))"
    },
    {
      "name": "savings_status_ordinal",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Ordinal encoding of savings account status from lowest to highest balance tier",
      "value_range": [0, 4],
      "feature_family": "account_status",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Provides ordered savings level for tree splits, capturing wealth buffer effect on creditworthiness",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "np.where(savings_status == 'no known savings', 0, np.where(savings_status == '<100', 1, np.where(savings_status == '100<=X<500', 2, np.where(savings_status == '500<=X<1000', 3, np.where(savings_status == '>=1000', 4, 0)))))"
    },
    {
      "name": "employment_ordinal",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Ordinal encoding of employment duration from unemployed to longest tenure",
      "value_range": [0, 4],
      "feature_family": "employment_stability",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Captures employment stability as ordered feature for tree splits on job security",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "np.where(employment == 'unemployed', 0, np.where(employment == '<1', 1, np.where(employment == '1<=X<4', 2, np.where(employment == '4<=X<7', 3, np.where(employment == '>=7', 4, 0)))))"
    },
    {
      "name": "monthly_payment_burden",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Estimated monthly payment as credit amount divided by duration, scaled by installment commitment rate",
      "value_range": [1.0, 15945.0],
      "feature_family": "repayment_capacity",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Captures monthly financial burden combining loan size, duration, and commitment rate for tree splits",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "(credit_amount / np.maximum(duration, 1)) * (installment_commitment / 4.0)"
    },
    {
      "name": "log_credit_amount",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Log-transformed credit amount to compress right-skewed distribution for better tree splits",
      "value_range": [5.5, 9.7],
      "feature_family": "loan_characteristics",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Reduces skewness in credit amount, enabling more balanced tree splits across loan size range",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "np.log1p(credit_amount)"
    },
    {
      "name": "high_risk_checking_flag",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Binary flag indicating negative or no checking account balance, both associated with higher financial risk",
      "value_range": [0, 1],
      "feature_family": "account_status",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Direct boolean split on most predictive checking account risk categories",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "np.where((checking_status == '<0') | (checking_status == 'no checking'), 1, 0)"
    },
    {
      "name": "credit_history_risk_score",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Numeric risk score derived from credit history category, with higher values indicating worse credit history",
      "value_range": [0, 4],
      "feature_family": "credit_history",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Converts nominal credit history into ordered risk scale for effective tree splits",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "np.where(credit_history == 'all paid', 4, np.where(credit_history == 'no credits/all paid', 3, np.where(credit_history == 'delayed previously', 2, np.where(credit_history == 'existing paid', 1, np.where(credit_history == 'critical/other existing credit', 0, 2)))))"
    },
    {
      "name": "long_duration_high_amount_flag",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Binary flag for loans that are both long duration (above 24 months) and high amount (above mean credit amount of 3778)",
      "value_range": [0, 1],
      "feature_family": "loan_characteristics",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Captures interaction between loan size and duration as a combined risk indicator for tree splits",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "np.where((duration > 24) & (credit_amount > 3778.0), 1, 0)"
    },
    {
      "name": "property_security_score",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Ordinal score for property collateral quality from no property to real estate",
      "value_range": [0, 3],
      "feature_family": "collateral",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Provides ordered collateral quality measure enabling tree splits on asset security",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "np.where(property_magnitude == 'no known property', 0, np.where(property_magnitude == 'life insurance', 1, np.where(property_magnitude == 'car', 2, np.where(property_magnitude == 'real estate', 3, 0))))"
    },
    {
      "name": "age_employment_stability_score",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Combined score of age bucket and employment duration ordinal, capturing life-stage financial stability",
      "value_range": [0, 8],
      "feature_family": "employment_stability",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Nonlinear interaction between age and employment tenure captures career stability patterns for tree splits",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "np.where(age < 25, 0, np.where(age < 35, 1, np.where(age < 50, 2, 3))) + np.where(employment == 'unemployed', 0, np.where(employment == '<1', 1, np.where(employment == '1<=X<4', 2, np.where(employment == '4<=X<7', 3, np.where(employment == '>=7', 5, 0)))))"
    },
    {
      "name": "financial_vulnerability_index",
      "type": "judgment",
      "description": "Semantic assessment of overall financial vulnerability combining checking account status, savings level, and employment stability into a composite risk score. Score 0 indicates strong financial position (positive checking, high savings, stable employment), score 10 indicates maximum vulnerability (negative checking, no savings, unemployed).",
      "value_range": [0, 10],
      "feature_family": "composite_risk",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Holistic financial vulnerability measure captures multi-dimensional risk that individual features may miss, providing strong tree split candidates",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true
    },
    {
      "name": "loan_purpose_risk_tier",
      "type": "judgment",
      "description": "Semantic risk tier for loan purpose based on typical repayment patterns and asset backing. Tier 1 (lowest risk, value 1): used car, real estate-backed purposes. Tier 2 (moderate risk, value 2): radio/tv, furniture/equipment, domestic appliance. Tier 3 (higher risk, value 3): new car, business, education. Tier 4 (highest risk, value 4): repairs, retraining, other unspecified purposes.",
      "value_range": [1, 4],
      "feature_family": "loan_characteristics",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Groups loan purposes by semantic risk profile enabling tree splits on purpose-based risk tiers rather than individual categories",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true
    }
  ]
}
